claim: Patchline ships a continual-evaluation harness on a live, growing benchmark with anti-overfitting audits. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the anti-overfitting claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make continual-evaluation-harness-gate`.
